# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# Load the simulated marine survey
marine_survey <- read_csv(here("data", "theme4_marine_ecology.csv"))
head(marine_survey)
```

# Tasks

1. Plot `boat_density_index` on the x-axis and `dolphin_detections` on the y-axis.
2. Render coordinates as points using `geom_point()`.
3. Map `site` to the point color aesthetic inside `aes()`.
4. Add a linear trendline using `geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)`.

Write your plotting code below:

```{r}
ggplot(marine_survey, aes(x = boat_density_index, y = dolphin_detections, color = site)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Dolphin Acoustic Detections vs. Boat Traffic",
    x = "Boat Density Index",
    y = "Dolphin Detections / Day",
    color = "Survey Site"
  )
```
